goalTurn: Progress: implemented socket-backed directory VFS and authenticated held-dirfd namespace operations with shared lookup ownership; proved ordinary Bionic/SIGSYS routing on VM73. Full Android12L goal remains active.
scope: Rootless directory VFS component against a real-file-backed FUSE wire test peer. Does not prove real MediaProvider policy, real AppFuse directory mounts, production trusted-core embedding or mounted external_primary.

implementation.carrier: AF_UNIX SOCK_SEQPACKET descriptor, abstract pocket.dir32 tag plus kernel SO_COOKIE and actual socket device/inode. Broker retains peer endpoint. Final kernel FD reference across dup/fork/SCM_RIGHTS triggers peer HUP and one provider release. No inotify event counting or guessed process-FD reference counts.
implementation.directorySyscalls: getdents64 converts live FUSE_READDIRPLUS results to aligned native dirent64 records. Cursor is shared per open description; read reply waits for client copy acknowledgment. EFAULT/disconnect does not consume entries. Rewind reopens the actual provider directory cursor. Logical flags, fresh attrs, seek, sync, EISDIR/ENOTSOCK/ENOTTY/ENODEV behavior are supplied by the loader.
implementation.relativeOperations: Request v2 reserved[1] selects first/second-path relative directory proofs. Exact ordered SCM_RIGHTS count and live caller identity are validated. No client supplies provider inode, file slot or cookie. openat, fstatat, mkdirat, unlinkat, renameat and access route from held provider nodes, including two directory proofs for rename; absolute paths ignore the supplied dirfd. No original pathname reconstruction is required.
implementation.lookupOwnership: Shared lookup-reference bundles outlive closed parent OPENDIR handles when relative-open children still depend on them. Failed operations release temporary LOOKUP references. Component peer asserts every non-root provider request still owns a lookup reference; all final refs/handles balance.
implementation.kernelInspection: Per-thread nested scope for the trusted logical UID0 broker only. Atomic PID/TID/depth words survive nested signals and fork; ordinary guest UID0 commands retain the VFS view. App UID10001 cannot enter the scope. This does not change host kernel credentials, provide root, or create a kernel isolation boundary.
implementation.selection: Namespace marker remains disabled in normal Manager profiles. Extra read/socket syscall traps are selected at interpreter startup; directory tests use a fresh host-launched loader process.
implementation.testDevice: The ordinary-libc directory-only child uses an explicit synthetic logical device ID different from the ordinary-file surrogate proof device, preventing Bionic libraries on the same kernel filesystem from being mistaken for AppFuse proxy files. It makes no claim to a real host proxy mount.
